sw_text_raw: Utinni! Utinni!\pMob un loo? Mob un loo?$
notes: Jawa trade talk: Utinni! = hurry, let us proceed (heard in A New Hope). Mob un loo? = what is the price?

sw_text_raw: M'um m'aloo!\pMombay m'bwa! Mombay m'bwa!\pTogo togu!$
notes: Jawaese: M'um m'aloo = hello. Jawa trade talk: Mombay m'bwa = that belongs to me; Togo togu! = do not touch! (he clutches his GRAPPLE LINE)

sw_text_raw: Achuta! Koona t'chuta?\pThe roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\pBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.$
notes: Huttese: Achuta = hello; Koona t'chuta? = going somewhere? (Greedo, A New Hope, subtitled "Going somewhere, Solo?")

sw_text_raw: Poodoo!\pIt's very difficult to make it stop\nright on “7.”\pIf it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME\nbonus game, you'll receive extra CHIPS.$
notes: Huttese: Poodoo! = an exclamation, literally fodder (Sebulba, The Phantom Menace)

sw_text_raw: Achuta, pateesa!\pIf you want to change your COMPANION's\nnickname, you'll have to get the NAME\lRATER to help you.$
notes: Huttese: Achuta, pateesa! = hello, friend!

sw_text_raw: Inkabunga! Pankpa!\pI get all giddy and gooey when\nI see a starship!\pFor me, RIC OLIé is the number\none role model!$
notes: Huttese: Inkabunga! = amazing!; Pankpa = spaceship

sw_text_raw: Chut chut!\pI just discovered the footprints of\na rare COMPANION!\pWait until I finish sketching\nthem, okay?$
notes: Huttese: Chut chut! = excuse me, never mind

sw_text_raw: I finished sketching the footprints of\na rare COMPANION.\pBut it turns out they were only my\nown footprints…\pPoodoo.$
notes: Huttese: Poodoo = rubbish, an exclamation (Sebulba, The Phantom Menace)

sw_text_raw: Punchee…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any COMPANION?$
notes: Huttese: Punchee = pal (Episode I Racer)

sw_text_raw:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between COMPANIONS.\pWell, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!\pInkabunga! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$
notes: Huttese: Inkabunga! = amazing!

sw_text_raw:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by\la colossal battle between COMPANIONS.\pWell, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!\pInkabunga! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!$
notes: Huttese: Inkabunga! = amazing!

sw_text_raw: Bedwana, bedwana…\pWhenever I visit here, I get carried\naway and buy too much.$
notes: Huttese: Bedwana = to buy

sw_text_raw: Chess ko!\pDon't you dare run around inside\nthe MUSEUM!$
notes: Huttese: Chess ko! = careful! (printed on Huttese barricade tape, canon)

sw_text_raw: Bo shuda!\nI know a winner when I see one!$
notes: Huttese: Bo shuda! = Jabba's exclamation (Return of the Jedi), never translated on screen

sw_text_raw: Inkabunga! You have COMPANIONS\nwith you, too.\pWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with COMPANIONS, too.$
notes: Huttese: Inkabunga! = amazing!

sw_text_raw: Achuta!\pDo COMPANIONS enjoy having items used\non them?\pMine danced all night after I gave\nit some PROTEIN.$
notes: Huttese: Achuta! = hello!

sw_text_raw: Chess ko!\pQuit pushing! This is the line,\ncan't you see?$
notes: Huttese: Chess ko! = careful! (a threat)

sw_text_raw: Wyaaaaaa.\p(The MARKET does have some\ninteresting merchandise.\pBut there are some items you can\nonly get at a SUPPLY DEPOT.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Wyaaaaaa = hello. Wookiees understand Basic but cannot speak it, so the meaning follows in brackets.

sw_text_raw:
Mmmmmmrrrrr.\p(It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…\pSpeaking of water, you know that
swamp world DAGOBAH?\pI think the ARENA there had a new
LEADER come in.\pPeople tell me the new LEADER once
mentored OBI-WAN.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Mmmmmmrrrrr = agreement, contentment

sw_text_raw: Hrung?\p(Everything starts with focus!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Hrung? = ready?

sw_text_raw: Ruh gwyaaaag.\p(The penetrating cold of HOTH is\nan impediment to training.\pBut with focus, one can overcome!\pWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down\nand withstand the cold!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Ruh gwyaaaag = I am a friend

sw_text_raw: Grrrrrupmprrr!\p(TM31 contains BRICK BREAK!\nIt's a move so horrible that I\lcan't describe it.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Grrrrrupmprrr! = disgust or irritation

sw_text_raw: Wyaaaaaa.\p(For thirty years I've remained in\nDAGOBAH honing my skills.\pI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Wyaaaaaa = hello

sw_text_raw: Yyyuurrrrrrruuunghh!\p(I was wondering which one would win,\nthe red one or the blue one…\pBut it's the green one that settles\nthings! Talk about a huge turn of\levents!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Yyyuurrrrrrruuunghh = roughly, what the Hutt is going on in here?

sw_text_raw: Grrrrrrrraaaaaarrrrph!\p(Go for it, red COMPANION!\nDon't back off, blue COMPANION!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Grrrrrrrraaaaaarrrrph = a roar with no known translation

sw_text_raw: Roooarrgh ur roo.\p(I have a bad feeling about this.\pDo you know the names of those\nCOMPANIONS fighting over there?)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Roooarrgh ur roo = I have a bad feeling about this

sw_text_raw: Mmmmmmrrrrr!\p(That goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Mmmmmmrrrrr = agreement, contentment. Replaces the made-up Nnn... Roar!

sw_text_raw:
Grrrrrupmprrr!\p(What's going on?\pI was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!\pThat tunnel's filled with COMPANIONS
that react badly to loud noises.\lThey could cause an uproar.\pThat's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling…\pI'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle the\lCOMPANION into an uproar.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Grrrrrupmprrr! = disgust or irritation

sw_text_raw: Grrrrrupmprrr!\p(I want to dig that tunnel!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Grrrrrupmprrr! = disgust or irritation

sw_text_raw: Grrgaaggaa!\p(Thanks to you, I can see my\ngirlfriend every day.\lHappy? You bet I am!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Grrgaaggaa = an expression of gratitude

sw_text_raw: Hrung?\p(I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Hrung? = ready?

sw_text_raw: Mmmmmmrrrrr.\p(So this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Mmmmmmrrrrr = agreement

sw_text_raw: Awwwrrrrrrrr.\p(I have this feeling that the little\ngirl is saying something profound.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Awwwrrrrrrrr = neither agreement nor disagreement

sw_text_raw: Grrrrafffffffffgrrr!\p(I entered the wrong SHOWCASE.\pI entered this tough COMPANION in\nthe SMARTNESS SHOWCASE…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-\nlooking ROCK SMASH.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Grrrrafffffffffgrrr! = a panicked expression

sw_text_raw: Mmmmmmrrrrr.\p(Master Rank SHOWCASES, here I come.\pThe galaxy will know that my dearest\nCOMPANION is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Mmmmmmrrrrr = agreement, contentment

sw_text_raw:
Wyaaaaaa.\p(For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy COMPANIONS are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
COMPANIONS are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.)\pArrrgrrr?\p(Why are you looking at me like that?)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Wyaaaaaa = hello; Arrrgrrr? = a questioning sound

sw_text_raw: Wyaaaaaa!\p(Yay! It's a starship!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Wyaaaaaa = hello

sw_text_raw: Awwwrrrrrrrr.\p(Our sand castle's taking a long time\nto make.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Awwwrrrrrrrr = neither yes nor no

sw_text_raw: Wyaaaaaa!\p(We're going to get all the sand from\nthe beach and make a big castle!\pAnd then we're going to be a king and\nqueen.\pWe'll let you be a servant.)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Wyaaaaaa = hello

sw_text_raw: Uma!\p(You can have this!)$
notes: Shyriiwook: Uma = yes

sw_text_raw: In all sorts of places, there are all\nsorts of COMPANIONS and people.\pI find that fascinating, so I go to all\nsorts of places.\pI have spoken.$
notes: Ugnaught custom: Ugnaughts end a final declaration with "I have spoken." (Kuiil, The Mandalorian)

sw_text_raw:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I will try my hand
at battling. I have spoken.$
notes: Ugnaught custom: "I have spoken." (Kuiil, The Mandalorian)

sw_text_raw: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, I will\nclimb the outside. I have spoken.$
notes: Ugnaught custom: "I have spoken." (Kuiil, The Mandalorian)

sw_text_raw: Yaa-yaah!\pThe ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water…\pBRIGHT TREE VILLAGE exists because\nthere's both water and soil.$
notes: Ewokese: Yaa-yaah! = greetings! Shown on an Ewok once net:walker-ewok replaces the villager's sprite.

sw_text_raw:
Yub nub!\pThe village is made of huts built
high in the trees.\pPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\pWhy, even myself--I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.$
notes: Ewokese: Yub nub! = hooray, freedom (the Return of the Jedi celebration)

sw_text_raw: Living on top of trees is okay.\pBut sometimes BUG COMPANIONS come in\nthrough windows.\pEe chee wa maa!\nIt can be really startling.$
notes: Ewokese: Ee chee wa maa! = wow!
